text_block_list.name: Fan Fest Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
We can't have a Fan Fest without food
stalls! We
need booths that sell things
like drinks and
desserts!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear voices coming from a classroom,
and when I
take a peek inside, I see a
group of students
avidly planning for the
Fan Fest.

text_block_list.name: Fan Fest Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I suppose we could play it
safe and
do a class cafe, but what do
you think, Pearl?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That might not be so bad, but
what we
really need is something fans
can't experience
anywhere else.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Since they're coming out all this way,
shouldn't we
treat them to something
special?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We must widen our minds and be flexible with our ideas! It's not enough to just think outside the box—we have to think over and beyond the box!

text_block_list.name: Fan Fest Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
Treat them to something special... Yeah,
that
would definitely make things more
interesting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl's rallying call inspires
the rest of
the students, and they begin
to excitedly discuss
their ideas for the
Fan Fest.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay, how about doing an
Uma-powered
merry-go-round?! We can
make a ride that we
manually push in
circles! What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Fan Fest Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
Why stop there? Let's add similar rides,
like
Uma-powered spinning cups!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Do you have something to add? Go
ahead,
we're all ears.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:

ahead,
we're all ears.

That's an interesting idea you've got there!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it won't be easy, but it's not
impossible to
bring to life either.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We just have to think of a way we can
we make
this dream into a reality!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
As long as we all put our heads
together, I'm sure
we can find a way! I
have no doubt everything'll
turn out
great!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. I wouldn't have been able to
think of it if
not for how inspired I was
by everyone's ideas.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's a spark of the most wonderful
potential
within each and every one of
them.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If we all work hard together, I'm sure we
can make
this Fan Fest the best in
history!
